mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sd_gis_dataset ( created_by, title, description, provider, source_type, spatial_type, file_format, original_srid, storage_srid, analysis_srid, is_spatial, is_public, category_id, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{description}, #{provider}, #{sourceType}, #{spatialType}, #{fileFormat}, #{originalSrid}, 4326, 5179,
false true , #{isPublic}, #{categoryId}, 'VALIDATING', now() )

INSERT INTO sd_gis_dataset_metadata ( dataset_id, keywords, data_start_date, data_end_date, temporal_coverage, spatial_coverage, update_cycle, license, quality_grade, quality_description, contact_person, contact_email, extra_metadata, created_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId},
string_to_array(#{keywords}, ',') null ,
CAST(#{dataStartDate} AS DATE) null ,
CAST(#{dataEndDate} AS DATE) null ,
#{temporalCoverage}, #{spatialCoverage}, #{updateCycle}, #{license}, #{qualityGrade}, #{qualityDescription}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactEmail},
CAST(#{extraMetadata} AS JSONB) null , now() )
INSERT INTO sd_upload_log ( dataset_id, user_id, upload_status, validation_status, started_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{createdBy}, 'UPLOADING', 'VALIDATING', now())

INSERT INTO sd_gis_dataset_file ( dataset_id, original_filename, stored_filename, file_extension, file_size, mime_type, encoding, file_role, checksum, file_path, created_at ) VALUES ( #{datasetId}, #{originalFilename}, '', #{fileExtension}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{encoding}, 'ORIGINAL', #{checksum}, '', now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_gis_dataset_file SET stored_filename = #{storedFilename}, file_path = #{filePath}, checksum = #{checksum} WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sd_upload_temp_feature ( upload_id, row_number, feature_name, raw_longitude, raw_latitude, raw_wkt, spatial_type, raw_data, validation_status ) VALUES
( #{item.uploadId}, #{item.rowNumber}, #{item.featureName}, #{item.rawLongitude}, #{item.rawLatitude}, #{item.rawWkt}, #{item.spatialType}, CAST(#{item.rawData} AS jsonb), #{item.validationStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.dataset_id, u.username, u.organization, d.title, l.success_count, d.created_at, d.status FROM sd_gis_dataset d INNER JOIN sd_user u ON d.created_by = u.user_id INNER JOIN sd_upload_log l ON d.dataset_id = l.dataset_id WHERE d.status = 'REQUEST' ORDER BY d.created_at desc

SELECT d.dataset_id AS datasetId, u.username AS username, u.organization AS organization, d.title AS title, COALESCE(l.success_count, 0) AS successCount, TO_CHAR(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM sd_gis_dataset d JOIN sd_user u ON d.created_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sd_upload_log l ON d.dataset_id = l.dataset_id WHERE d.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY l.upload_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT upload_id FROM sd_upload_log WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY upload_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_gis_feature ( dataset_id, feature_name, spatial_type, properties, geom_4326, geom_5179, created_at ) SELECT #{datasetId}, feature_name, spatial_type, raw_data, geom_4326, ST_Transform(geom_4326, 5179), NOW() FROM sd_upload_temp_feature WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'VALID'
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_upload_log SET upload_status = 'COMPLETED', import_status = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = NOW() WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
UPDATE sd_gis_dataset SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{adminUserId}, approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM sd_gis_dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sd_dataset_rejection (dataset_id, rejected_by, reject_reason, rejected_at) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{adminUserId}, #{rejectReason}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_upload_log SET upload_status = 'REJECTED', validation_status = 'REJECTED', finished_at = NOW() WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
UPDATE sd_gis_dataset_file SET stored_filename = '', file_path = '' WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
UPDATE sd_gis_dataset SET status = 'REJECTED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.dataset_id AS datasetId, d.title AS title, c.category_name_ko AS category, d.file_format AS fileFormat, d.status AS status, TO_CHAR(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, u.username AS "rejectionDetails.adminName", r.reject_reason AS "rejectionDetails.rejectReason", TO_CHAR(r.rejected_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "rejectionDetails.rejectedAt" FROM sd_gis_dataset d LEFT JOIN sd_data_category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN sd_dataset_rejection r ON d.dataset_id = r.dataset_id LEFT JOIN sd_user u ON r.rejected_by = u.user_id WHERE d.created_by = #{userId} AND d.status IN ('REQUEST', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
